item: row 299: a repair on a WAL store names the folded main file alone, and a cut repair finishes at the next start
summary: The swap hard-linked the live log beside the damaged file's second name; after a cut at the replace SQLite recreated the log under a new inode and every later start's resume failed with FileExistsError, and a discarded copy left an empty log name behind. The damaged copy is now the folded main file alone (checked again at the moment of naming), an empty leftover log name is removed, and anything else there or a damaged name held by another file is left in place untouched while the repair finishes under the next free numbered name and says so (x12), and every cut point resumes to completion on plaintext and SQLCipher WAL stores with saves pending in the log.
